title: Analysis code for: Alveolar-capillary cell composition and diffusing capacity unexplained by airflow limitation and emphysema in COPD lung tissue
description:
Analysis code and derived results for a study of diffusing capacity (DLCO) that is not explained by airflow limitation and CT emphysema in COPD lung tissue, using the public microarray dataset GSE47460 (Lung Genomics Research Consortium / Lung Tissue Research Consortium) and the single-cell reference GSE136831.

Surgical lung tissue from 177 COPD patients was analysed separately on the dataset's two Agilent microarray platforms (GPL14550, n = 118; GPL6480, n = 59) and combined by inverse-variance meta-analysis, with adjustment for FEV1, CT emphysema, age, sex and smoking. No gene-level association replicated across platforms, whereas the estimated alveolar-capillary cell fraction was higher in patients with higher DLCO.

The primary expression data are not redistributed here; they are publicly available in NCBI GEO.
